recommendations.recommendation: Prioritize deep work, meaning distraction-free concentration on cognitively demanding tasks.
recommendations.rationale: Deep work is rare and valuable in the modern economy, and it lets you learn hard things quickly and produce more.

recommendations.recommendation: Schedule deep work on a fixed routine, with rules about where, when, and how long.
recommendations.rationale: Willpower is limited, so routines reduce the effort needed to start and sustain focus.

recommendations.recommendation: Choose a deep work style that fits your life: monastic, bimodal, rhythmic, or journalistic.
recommendations.rationale: Different jobs and temperaments suit different levels of isolation and scheduling.

recommendations.recommendation: Embrace boredom and train focus; do not switch to distraction at every brief pause.
recommendations.rationale: The ability to concentrate is a trained skill that frequent switching erodes.

recommendations.recommendation: Quit social media or evaluate each tool by whether its benefits clearly outweigh its costs.
recommendations.rationale: Network tools fragment attention, and most offer only small benefits compared with their costs.
recommendations.argued_against: Using every tool that has any benefit

recommendations.recommendation: Schedule every minute of your workday into blocks and adjust the plan as interruptions arise.
recommendations.rationale: Planned time is spent on purpose rather than drifting to whatever is urgent.

recommendations.recommendation: Quantify the depth of each task and cut shallow work to a strict budget.
recommendations.rationale: Shallow tasks expand if unchecked and crowd out deep work.

recommendations.recommendation: Finish work at a fixed time and shut down completely in the evening.
recommendations.rationale: Downtime lets the brain recharge and improves the next day's deep work.

recommendations.recommendation: Create a ritual of grand gestures or rules to support focus, such as going away to write.
recommendations.rationale: Costly commitments signal the importance of the task and help maintain focus.

recommendations.recommendation: Practice productive meditation: focus on one problem while doing physical activity such as walking.
recommendations.rationale: It uses otherwise idle time to make progress and builds concentration.

recommendations.recommendation: Memorize or concentrate on structured material to improve your concentration.
recommendations.rationale: Practice with deliberate focus strengthens mental capacity.

recommendations.recommendation: Follow the 4 disciplines of execution: focus on a few wildly important goals, track lead measures, keep a scoreboard, hold regular reviews.
recommendations.rationale: Clear measures and accountability turn intentions into results.
